name: pdftomarkdown-ai
description: Converts local PDFs (plus Word, PowerPoint, Excel, images, HTML, and EPUB files supported by the API) into clean, structured Markdown with headings, tables, and OCR text preserved, through the PDFtoMarkdown.ai API. Exposes a convert_pdf_to_markdown tool for MCP clients.

PDFTOMARKDOWN_API_KEY.description: API key from https://pdftomarkdown.ai/account (free tier available)

npm.description: Local stdio server from npm (requires Node.js 18+)

tools.name: convert_pdf_to_markdown
tools.description: Convert a local PDF file to clean, structured Markdown.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the PDF file to convert

force_ocr.description: Enable Force OCR for scanned PDFs (default: false)

examples.title: Convert a PDF
examples.description: Turn a local PDF into Markdown
examples.prompt: Convert ~/Documents/report.pdf to Markdown and summarize the key tables.

examples.title: Scanned document
examples.description: Use OCR on a scanned PDF
examples.prompt: Convert this scanned invoice PDF to Markdown with OCR turned on.
